what: Every call under scripts\ that reaches the VPS, what it sends, and the class it needs. Read from the code, not from script names. docs\DEPLOY-IDENTITIES.md section 2 is corrected from this. tests\test-remote-command-map.ps1 keeps it in step with the scripts.
key: script|scope|via#n: scope is the function the call sits in (<top> outside one); n counts calls with the same script, scope and via, in file order

classes.stage: write or check a stage folder or a file the deploy owns
classes.swap: swap a stage in and record what is live
classes.feed-send: write the feed, news or site files store
classes.task-start-stop: start or stop a named Thornswood task
classes.read-status: read files, settings, logs or status only
classes.admin: needs Administrator: install, service, task registration, ACL, firewall, keys, secrets, or work outside the gate verbs
classes.transport: a helper that carries what its caller hands it; the caller is the row that counts
